section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the hypotheses for a study validating the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) instrument. The researchers hypothesize that BAS-2 items will form a unidimensional structure for both women and men, demonstrate internal consistency and test-retest reliability over 3 weeks, and show construct validity through expected relationships with body-related variables (appearance evaluation, body dissatisfaction, internalization, body surveillance) and psychological well-being indices (self-esteem, coping). Additionally, they predict BAS-2 scores will correlate with eating behaviors and demonstrate incremental validity beyond negative body image and appearance evaluation measures.
